newsitem.title: UK: Bodycote buys U.S. Hinterliter for $13.25mln.
newsitem.headline: Bodycote buys U.S. Hinterliter for $13.25mln.

text.p: Bodycote International Plc said it had bought Hinderliter Heat Treating Inc of Dallas, Texas, for $13.25 million of which $8.215 million would be satisfied with the issue of one million shares in the company.
Hinderliter offers a range of metallurgical services from locations in Texas, Oklahoma and California in the U.S. and Ontario in Canada.
Bodycote said the acquisition was "an integral part of (its) strategic plan to establish a network of heat treatment facilities in the USA."
Hinderliter had adjusted pretax profits of $2.03 million in the year ending June 30 and net assets were $1.37 million.
